name: dropdown-menu
behavior: APG menu button pattern (trigger has aria-haspopup=menu + aria-expanded; Enter/Space/Down opens and focuses first item; arrow keys rove focus; typeahead; Esc closes and returns focus to trigger; role=menu / role=menuitem)

parts.note: typically a button — anatomy delegated to anatomy/button.json; carries the expand icon role when rendered with an indicator

anatomyNotes: A destructive item is emphasis:danger applied at item level: label and icon recolor with status-critical (hover recipe may use status-critical-surface) — same anatomy, no extra part. Checkbox/radio items are the item part plus the select option-indicator pattern.
